<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a4a1e330dadc46cca04cf406be9aea2f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5rGf5Z-O5byA5pyX55qE6LGM6LGG:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1758032603&amp;x-signature=sKxGpM6fRSixNRUexawlJ4iKElE%3D" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-03_13-45-06.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 我一直认为技术的不断探索和实践是进步的源泉，近年来，我深入研究大数据算法的应用与发展，尤其在数据可视化和交互体验方面，取得了显著的成果。我也注重与团队的合作，能够有效地推动项目的进展和优化开发流程。现在，我担任全栈工程师，拥有CSDN博客专家认证及阿里云专家博主称号，希望通过分享我的技术心得与经验，帮助更多人提升自己的技术水平，成为更优秀的开发者。</p>
<p>技术qq交流群：<code>906392632</code></p>
<p>大家好，我是小杨，一个做了6年前端的老司机。今天想和大家聊聊一个常见但头疼的问题：<strong>如何在不卡死页面的情况下渲染大量数据？</strong></p>
<p>不知道你有没有遇到过这样的场景：后端一次性返回几万条数据，前端直接&nbsp;<code>forEach</code>&nbsp;+&nbsp;<code>appendChild</code>&nbsp;暴力渲染，结果页面直接卡死，用户疯狂投诉……（别问我怎么知道的 😅）</p>
<p>其实，解决这个问题并不难，关键在于<strong>分批渲染</strong>，而&nbsp;<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>（简称&nbsp;<code>rAF</code>）就是我们的最佳帮手！</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0"><strong>1. 为什么直接渲染大数据会卡？</strong></h2>
<p>假设我们有 10,000 条数据，如果一次性全部塞进 DOM：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10000</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">fill</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"我是数据项"</span>);  
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> container = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'list'</span>);  

data.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">item</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> div = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>);
  div.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = item;
  container.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(div);
});
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题来了：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>JS 执行阻塞</strong>：一次性创建 10,000 个 DOM 节点，JS 引擎会卡住主线程。</li>
<li><strong>渲染延迟</strong>：浏览器需要处理大量 DOM 插入，导致页面冻结，用户无法交互。</li>
<li><strong>内存占用高</strong>：大量 DOM 节点堆积，内存飙升，甚至可能崩溃。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>结论：</strong> &nbsp;<strong>不能一次性渲染所有数据！</strong></p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1"><strong>2. 解决方案：分批渲染 + requestAnimationFrame</strong></h2>
<p><code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;是浏览器提供的 API，它会在<strong>下一次重绘之前</strong>执行回调，通常是&nbsp;<strong>16.6ms（60FPS）</strong> &nbsp;执行一次，这样可以让渲染更流畅。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2"><strong>优化思路：</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>分批次渲染</strong>：每次只渲染一小部分数据（比如 50 条）。</li>
<li><strong>利用&nbsp;<code>rAF</code>&nbsp;控制渲染时机</strong>，避免阻塞主线程。</li>
<li><strong>滚动加载优化</strong>（可选）：结合&nbsp;<code>IntersectionObserver</code>&nbsp;实现懒加载。</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-id="heading-3"><strong>代码实现：</strong></h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">renderLargeData</span>(<span class="hljs-params">data, chunkSize = <span class="hljs-number">50</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> container = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'list'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> index = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">renderChunk</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 每次渲染 chunkSize 条数据</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> chunkEnd = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(index + chunkSize, data.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (; index &lt; chunkEnd; index++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> div = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>);
      div.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = 我是.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[index];
      container.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(div);
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果还有数据，继续渲染</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (index &lt; data.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimationFrame</span>(renderChunk);
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 开始渲染</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">renderChunk</span>();
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bigData = <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10000</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">fill</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"我是数据项"</span>);
<span class="hljs-title function_">renderLargeData</span>(bigData);
</code></pre>
<p><strong>优化效果：</strong><br>
✅&nbsp;<strong>页面不卡顿</strong>：每次只渲染少量 DOM，主线程不会被阻塞。<br>
✅&nbsp;<strong>流畅渲染</strong>：<code>rAF</code>&nbsp;确保在浏览器空闲时执行，不影响用户交互。<br>
✅&nbsp;<strong>内存可控</strong>：不会一次性创建大量 DOM，减少内存压力。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-4"><strong>3. 进阶优化：虚拟滚动（Virtual Scroll）</strong></h2>
<p>如果你的数据量真的超级大（比如 10W+），即使分批渲染也会占用大量 DOM，这时可以考虑&nbsp;<strong>虚拟滚动</strong>（只渲染可视区域内的元素）。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5"><strong>核心思路：</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>只渲染可见区域的数据</strong>，滚动时动态替换内容。</li>
<li>使用&nbsp;<code>IntersectionObserver</code>&nbsp;或监听&nbsp;<code>scroll</code>&nbsp;事件计算可视范围。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 简单示例（完整实现会更复杂）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">renderVirtualScroll</span>(<span class="hljs-params">data, container, itemHeight = <span class="hljs-number">50</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> viewportHeight = container.<span class="hljs-property">clientHeight</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> visibleItemCount = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ceil</span>(viewportHeight / itemHeight);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> startIndex = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateVisibleItems</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> endIndex = startIndex + visibleItemCount;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> visibleData = data.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(startIndex, endIndex);

    container.<span class="hljs-property">innerHTML</span> = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
    visibleData.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">item</span> =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> div = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>);
      div.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${itemHeight}</span>px`</span>;
      div.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = 我是.<span class="hljs-property">item</span>;
      container.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(div);
    });
  }

  container.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    startIndex = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(container.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTop</span> / itemHeight);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">updateVisibleItems</span>();
  });

  <span class="hljs-title function_">updateVisibleItems</span>();
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>适用场景：</strong><br>
📌 超长列表（如聊天记录、日志数据）<br>
📌 表格数据渲染<br>
📌 无限滚动（Infinite Scroll）</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-6"><strong>4. 总结：如何选择优化方案？</strong></h2>























<table><thead><tr><th>方案</th><th>适用场景</th><th>优点</th><th>缺点</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>分批渲染（<code>rAF</code>）</strong></td><td>数据量中等（1k~10k）</td><td>实现简单，兼容性好</td><td>DOM 节点仍较多</td></tr><tr><td><strong>虚拟滚动</strong></td><td>数据量超大（10k+）</td><td>极致性能，内存占用低</td><td>实现较复杂</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>我的建议：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>如果数据量&nbsp; <strong>&lt; 5000</strong>，直接渲染问题不大。</li>
<li>如果数据量&nbsp;<strong>5000~10W</strong>，用&nbsp;<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;分批渲染。</li>
<li>如果数据量&nbsp; <strong>&gt; 10W</strong>，考虑虚拟滚动或后端分页。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-7"><strong>5. 最后的小技巧</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>setTimeout</code>&nbsp;vs&nbsp;<code>rAF</code></strong>：<code>rAF</code>&nbsp;比&nbsp;<code>setTimeout</code>&nbsp;更适合动画/渲染，因为它与浏览器刷新率同步。</li>
<li><strong>Web Worker</strong>：如果数据处理很耗时（如排序、过滤），可以丢给 Web Worker，避免阻塞 UI。</li>
<li><strong>分页加载</strong>：如果可能，尽量让后端分页，减少前端压力。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-8"><strong>结语</strong></h3>
<p>渲染大数据并不可怕，关键是要<strong>避免阻塞主线程</strong>。<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;是一个强大的工具，合理使用能让你的页面丝滑流畅！</p></div></div>
